purpose.summary: Align the public legacy matrix file declaration with its accepted record without changing node behavior or consensus.
scope: Bind the runner to the exact signed ERGON-CHANGE-0003 parent and its two modified harness paths.
Check all runner file metadata declarations directly against the accepted current record before public evidence can run.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, activation, native-asset, optional-indexing, testnet, or mainnet-parameter change.
No private source, history, operator material, host metadata, binary, or incoming evidence.

signature_policy.public_key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFN47Qs8VW9ty+v0tf31kv6pMpyOMxWWLXZ0Pv5MWVCI Ergon Lab Git commit signing (ErgonSurfer)

exclusions: Private history, operator material, host metadata, and unrelated private product material are excluded.

files.test_reachability: Runs the identity-bound fail-closed public evidence matrix.
Covers runner contracts, record binding, and fail-closed paths.

commands: Configure and build the exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 public baseline with the reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The baseline daemon is bound to the exact baseline commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

commands: Configure and build the exact direct-child public correction with the same reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The candidate daemon is bound to the reviewed correction commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

scenarios.command: Run the governed two-node legacy/candidate coexistence scenario.
expected_results: Alternating mining, relay, restart, chain, UTXO commitment, and raw-tip projections match.
failure_conditions: Any process, chain, UTXO, raw-tip, cleanup, identity, or success-marker divergence fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the baseline daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact baseline role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the candidate daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact candidate role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged inherited feature_abortnode.py selection through its default node-launch path.
expected_results: The inherited default-launch scenario passes with byte-equivalent selection.
failure_conditions: Any inherited-selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 with the reviewed public dependency profile
macOS arm64 local contradiction testing only

limitations: The signed ERGON-CHANGE-0003 commit and its baseline and candidate builds succeeded, but no compatibility scenario ran because the matrix rejected a file declaration mismatch before execution.
This change aligns only harness metadata and adds a metadata-binding self-test; it does not itself establish any legacy-compatibility runtime result.
A future successful four-scenario matrix may reproduce only the corrected ERGON-CHANGE-0004 state; it cannot retroactively reproduce ERGON-CHANGE-0001, ERGON-CHANGE-0002, or ERGON-CHANGE-0003.
Phase 2 remains open: reindex, pruning, and reorganization gates are separate later legacy-only changes.
Binary digests and config.ini source/build bindings do not prove build causality.
The dependency profile is not locked, and operator-binary equivalence and mainnet coexistence remain unproved.
If origin/main advances before reconstruction, the parent and all controlled preimages must be reviewed again instead of rebasing silently.
counterevidence: The signed public ERGON-CHANGE-0003 record declares the self-test reachability as Covers runner contracts, parent-record binding, and fail-closed paths. while its runner declares Covers runner contracts and fail-closed paths.; the unequal strings make the matrix stop before every scenario.
The successful public baseline and candidate builds do not supply a coexistence, mining, restart, or inherited-default-launch result.

An aligned unpublished runner copy passed all four scenarios against the public builds, but that local diagnostic is not public evidence and cannot promote the Open Question status; no signed public correction commit or public evidence artifact exists.
